sourceRefs.locator: Smithsonian Libraries and Archives, BHL item 238774, single foldout map, compiled from the original surveys, 1857. Compare the Chagres, the railway alignment, and the track profile along the left edge. Item-level Copyright & Usage identifies the work as public domain; DOI 10.5962/bhl.title.140712.

labels.de: Thomas Harrisons Karte der Panamabahn von 1857
labels.en: Thomas Harrison’s 1857 map of the Panama Railroad

alt.de: Die Karte zeichnet die Bahn zwischen den beiden Meeren in das Relief der Landenge. Der Chagres windet sich durch die Mitte. Am linken Blattrand verläuft ein schmales Höhenprofil der Strecke.
alt.en: The railway crosses the relief of the isthmus between the two seas. The Chagres winds across the interior. A narrow profile along the left margin traces the rise and fall of the line.

creators: Thomas Harrison, R. F. Storm and Endicott & Co., after surveys for chief engineer George M. Totten
